compatibility: Retains v3.5 measurement fields and historical KWS FKeras definitions; adds published-form FKeras on pinned ResNet-8 and ToyCar only.

estimator_predictions.csv.score: within-bit-tier magnitude of the signed published Hessian projection for the separately named continuous companion loss; repeated over the eight bits of a kernel word
estimator_predictions.csv.signed_prediction: null; this parameter projection is not a signed finite-bit loss prediction

scientific_payload.json.estimator_definitions: saves eigenvectors, signed eigenvalues, raw parameter scores, exact tensor offsets and quantization metadata, residual/symmetry/orthogonality diagnostics, source pin and bounded work options
scientific_payload.json.toycar_surrogate: continuous per-window reconstruction MSE; exact mask effectiveness uses complete-file 1-ROC-AUC

summary.json.mask_equivalence: actual mask-set equality at equal coverage, including complete INT8 bit tiers
summary.json.fkeras_diagnostics: numerical provenance copied from the saved estimator output
